required_facts_checked: DataTalks.Club has launched recurring free-course cohorts since 2021, with repeated questions arriving in Slack.
The first FAQ used shared Google Docs, including a one-point leaderboard incentive for useful contributions.
Open-document moderation problems included repeated vandalism, and the FAQ grew to about 1,300 entries, with roughly 500 for Data Engineering Zoomcamp.
Community member Alex Litvinov built the RAG-powered Slack bot.
The bot ingests FAQ entries, Slack history, GitHub repositories and YouTube subtitles with source-specific chunking.
The bot's daily Prefect/Docker pipeline uses LlamaIndex, BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5, Zilliz Cloud, Cohere Rerank and GPT-4o-mini, among other components.
The bot routes by Slack channel ID, retrieves 20 documents, applies time weighting and reranks to four.
The FAQ migrated to Git and a static site after Google Docs moderation and parsing problems.
Google Docs were downloaded as DOCX, parsed with Python's docx module into JSON, and cleaned by GPT-4o.
A custom Python generator with GitHub Copilot help replaced Jekyll because dbt's Jinja syntax conflicted with Liquid, and it exports JSON indexes as well as HTML.
Fred Pearce built the GitHub Actions orchestration around the FAQ Automation Bot.
The bot's structured decision can be NEW, UPDATE or DUPLICATE, and Claude Code reviews pull requests because human review remains necessary.
